description: Defines data models for users, tests, and submissions in a digital testing platform, including utility functions for UUID generation and timestamp handling.

classes.name: BaseModel
classes.description: Base class providing common fields (id, created_at, updated_at) and methods for timestamp updates and serialization.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a platform user with validation for email, name, and role.

classes.name: Test
classes.description: Represents a digital test with validation for title and author_id.

classes.name: Submission
classes.description: Represents a user's submission to a test, including answers, score, status, and optional evaluation notes.

methods.name: _utcnow_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ISO format with 'Z' suffix.

methods.name: touch
methods.description: Updates the 'updated_at' timestamp to current UTC time.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Serializes the model instance to a dictionary suitable for JSON encoding.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates fields of User, Test, and Submission instances.
